svg.title: A complete derivative solution has a planning stage and a checking stage
svg.desc: Reliable differentiation separates structure recognition, rule application, simplification, and verification. Skipping planning is faster only until it produces a derivative of the wrong expression. The derivative calculation is the middle of the process, not the whole process. A short rule plan prevents missing chain-rule factors. A final check catches impossible signs, units, or domains. When an error appears, trace backward to the earliest incorrect decision rather than randomly changing algebra at the end. The visual uses labeled positions, solid and dashed line styles, and written descriptions so a complete derivative solution has a planning stage and a checking stage does not depend on color.
